import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import io
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker

# Prepare the data
csv_data = """brand,model_year,megapixels,max_iso,weight_grams,price_usd,sensor_type,has_video_4k,lens_mount,body_type
Leica,2005,13.5,25600,324,811.8,Micro 4/3,1,E,Compact
Fuji,2019,46.4,51200,1151,3596.41,APS-C,0,EF,Mirrorless
Pentax,2012,38.7,12800,598,3357.2,Full Frame,0,MFT,Mirrorless
Olympus,2015,22.5,6400,1095,1555.7,APS-C,0,Z,Mirrorless
Leica,2016,12.2,25600,290,3899.09,Medium Format,0,MFT,DSLR
"""
df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(csv_data))

# Set a professional and visually appealing style
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", palette="viridis")

# Create a 2x2 subplot grid for a comprehensive overview
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Key Camera Specifications vs. Price Analysis', fontsize=22, weight='bold', y=1.02)

# --- Plot 1: Price vs. Megapixels, sized by weight ---
scatter1 = sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='megapixels',
    y='price_usd',
    hue='sensor_type',
    size='weight_grams',
    sizes=(150, 600),
    palette='magma',
    edgecolor='black',
    alpha=0.8,
    ax=axes[0, 0]
)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Price vs. Megapixels', fontsize=16, weight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Megapixels (MP)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].yaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.StrMethodFormatter('${x:,.0f}'))
axes[0, 0].legend(title='Sensor & Weight (g)', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# --- Plot 2: Price vs. Max ISO, styled by 4K video capability ---
scatter2 = sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='max_iso',
    y='price_usd',
    hue='brand',
    style='has_video_4k',
    s=250,
    ax=axes[0, 1],
    edgecolor='black',
    alpha=0.8
)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Price vs. Max ISO (Log Scale)', fontsize=16, weight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Maximum ISO', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_xscale('log') # Log scale is ideal for ISO ranges
axes[0, 1].xaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.ScalarFormatter())
axes[0, 1].yaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.StrMethodFormatter('${x:,.0f}'))
axes[0, 1].legend(title='Brand & 4K Video', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# --- Plot 3: Price vs. Model Year with annotations ---
line1 = sns.lineplot(
    data=df.sort_values('model_year'),
    x='model_year',
    y='price_usd',
    ax=axes[1, 0],
    marker='o',
    markersize=10,
    hue='brand',
    legend=False,
    lw=2.5
)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Price Trend by Model Year', fontsize=16, weight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].yaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.StrMethodFormatter('${x:,.0f}'))
for i, row in df.iterrows():
    axes[1, 0].text(row['model_year'], row['price_usd'] + 150, f"{row['brand']}\n(${row['price_usd']:.0f})",
                    fontsize=10, ha='center', va='bottom', weight='semibold')
axes[1, 0].set_ylim(bottom=0)

# --- Plot 4: Price Distribution by Body Type ---
sns.stripplot(
    data=df,
    x='body_type',
    y='price_usd',
    hue='brand',
    s=15,
    jitter=0.1,
    ax=axes[1, 1],
    linewidth=1.5,
    edgecolor='gray',
    legend=False
)
sns.boxplot(
    data=df,
    x='body_type',
    y='price_usd',
    ax=axes[1, 1],
    boxprops=dict(alpha=0.2, zorder=0),
    showfliers=False,
    whiskerprops={'linewidth':0},
    showcaps=False,
    width=0.6,
    palette='pastel'
)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Price by Body Type', fontsize=16, weight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Body Type', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].yaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.StrMethodFormatter('${x:,.0f}'))

# Final adjustments and saving the file
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 0.9, 1])
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
